description: Defines the small set of promotional/news banners shown on the main menu, including their localized message key, artwork, unlock-progress gate, and display order.

Id.technical: FName row key. RefreshBanners collects the rows, drops those whose UserProgressFlag is -1, and uses each surviving row's Id to build BannerIds; unacquired banners are ordered before acquired ones, and the first is passed to SetBanner. SetBanner also looks a row up by this name in each table in BannerDataTables, stopping at the first hit and silently doing nothing when no row matches.

Id_BannerMessage.simple: Localized text key for the banner caption.
Id_BannerMessage.technical: FName passed to BannerText->SetTextIdOnly when the banner becomes current; the exported rows use GLS_NAME_DLC_* keys. It is a localization key, not literal display text.

BannerTextureName.technical: FName resolved through the widget manager's FindDynamicLoadTexture and supplied to BannerButton->SetBannerTextures as the large texture. Main-menu startup also collects every banner's large and small names into WidgetTexture primary-asset loaders so both variants are preloaded.

SmallBannerTextureName.technical: FName resolved through FindDynamicLoadTexture and supplied to BannerButton->SetBannerTextures as the small texture; also included in the main-menu WidgetTexture prefetch list.

UserProgressFlag.simple: Progress bit that decides whether the banner is already acquired/unlocked.
UserProgressFlag.technical: int32 encoded as an index into AGameManager::UserInfo.UserProgressFlagWords: low two bits select one of four bits in word (Flag >> 2); words outside 0..127 are treated as unset. SetBanner uses it to swap NewIcon/AcquiredIcon visibility. RefreshBanners explicitly skips rows with -1, partitions the rest by the flag, and places unacquired rows first in the carousel. The manager loads BannerDataTable into BannerDataTables at +0xB60.

notes: The manager supports more than one BannerDataTable object in BannerDataTables; consumers iterate all of them and use the first table containing the requested row, so row names must be unique across shards to avoid shadowing.

The export contains four rows (BANNER_0110, BANNER_0120, BANNER_0220, and one more); it is the exported retail table, not a complete statement about all possible localization or platform-specific tables.
The reconstruction comments identify a non-warning row lookup; a missing row leaves SetBanner without a current banner update rather than logging an error.

usages.detail: Resolves the BannerDataTable loader and adds it to the BannerDataTables array consumed by the UI.
Collects all FGameDataTableRow_Banner rows from BannerDataTables to build one pagination icon per banner.
SetBanner selects a row by ID, tests its progress flag, sets the localized caption and large/small textures, and updates carousel pagination.
RefreshBanners filters flag -1 rows and orders unacquired banners before acquired ones.
Main-menu startup prefetches every banner texture through GamePrimaryAssetType_WidgetTexture.
